answer: Zero-knowledge passport proofs curb Sybil attacks by verifying an e-passport chip signature inside a SNARK to derive a unique nullifier without exposing personal data. Verified agents climb an access terrace to claim protocol nectar like fee rebates, anchored by a basalt registry of state public keys. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of acquiring a distinct physical document per clone. However, corrupt issuers or credential rental markets can still supply valid proofs at scale.
